asset.title: No-show policy template for appointment businesses
asset.intro: For owners and front-desk managers of salons, clinics, studios and other appointment businesses. Fill in the blanks and you'll have a no-show and cancellation policy you can post today and apply the same way to every client.
how_to_use: Work through the 9 sections in order and replace each [bracketed] blank with your own rule. The example under each section shows a finished line.
Post the finished policy on your booking page, in your confirmation email and at the front desk.
Apply it the same way to every client for a month, then adjust the numbers if slots still go empty.

sections.heading: Who the policy covers
sections.fill_in: [Business name] appointment policy, for all [services] booked online, by phone or in person.
sections.instruction: Name every way clients book, so nobody can say the policy didn't apply to them.
sections.example: Example Hair Studio appointment policy, for all cuts, color and treatments booked online, by phone or in person.

sections.heading: How to cancel or move a booking
sections.fill_in: You can cancel or move your appointment up to [number] hours before it starts, using [the link in your reminder / a call to phone number / a reply to our text].
sections.instruction: Pick a window long enough for you to refill the slot: the time it usually takes you to rebook a cancelled appointment.
sections.example: You can cancel or move your appointment up to 24 hours before it starts, using the link in your reminder text or by calling (555) 010-0142.

sections.heading: Late cancellations
sections.fill_in: If you cancel with less than [number] hours' notice, we [keep your deposit / charge amount or % of the service price].
sections.instruction: State the exact charge. "We may charge a fee" is hard to apply and easy to dispute.
sections.example: If you cancel with less than 24 hours' notice, we keep your deposit.

sections.heading: No-shows
sections.fill_in: If you miss your appointment without telling us, we charge [amount or % of the service price]. After [number] missed appointments, we [ask for full payment when you book / stop taking online bookings for you].
sections.instruction: Size the charge to what the empty slot costs you (the deposit, or a share of the service price) and set what happens after repeat no-shows, so the front desk never decides on the spot.
sections.example: If you miss your appointment without telling us, we charge 50% of the booked service. After 2 missed appointments, we ask for full payment when you book.

sections.heading: Arriving late
sections.fill_in: If you arrive more than [number] minutes late, we [shorten your service / rebook you and apply the late-cancellation charge] so the next client isn't kept waiting.
sections.instruction: Use the shortest service you offer to set the number: past that point the slot can't be saved.
sections.example: If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, we may shorten your service or rebook you, and the late-cancellation charge applies.

sections.heading: Deposits and card on file
sections.fill_in: To book [which services], we take [a deposit of amount or % / a card on file]. It [comes off your bill / is refunded if you cancel in time], and we only charge the card when [the late-cancellation or no-show rule applies].
sections.instruction: Say exactly when the card is charged and when the money comes back. Clients ask about this first.
sections.example: To book color or any service over 90 minutes, we take a $20 deposit. It comes off your bill, or goes back to your card if you cancel 24 hours or more ahead.

sections.heading: Exceptions
sections.fill_in: We waive the charge for [illness, emergencies, severe weather] when you let us know before your appointment time, [once every number months].
sections.instruction: One clear exception keeps goodwill without turning every no-show into a negotiation.
sections.example: We waive the charge for illness or emergencies when you let us know before your appointment time, once every 6 months.

sections.heading: How we remind you
sections.fill_in: We send a reminder [number] hours before your appointment by [text / email / both], with a link to confirm, move or cancel.
sections.instruction: A reminder with a one-tap cancel link turns a forgotten appointment into a cancellation you can still refill.
sections.example: We send a reminder 48 hours and again 2 hours before your appointment, by text and email, with a link to confirm, move or cancel.

sections.heading: Agreeing to the policy
sections.fill_in: By booking, you agree to this policy. You'll see it [on the booking page / in your confirmation email / at the front desk].
sections.instruction: Show it before the client books and again in the confirmation. A policy nobody saw is hard to enforce.
sections.example: By booking, you agree to this policy. You'll see it on our booking page, where you tick to accept it, and in your confirmation email.

asset.local_rules_note: Rules on charging fees and keeping deposits differ by country and state. Check the rules where you operate before you charge.
asset.closing_line: Example Booking Software can show this policy on your booking page, ask clients to tick that they accept it, take the deposit and send the reminders for you.

subject_options: Here's the no-show policy template you asked for
delivery_email.preview_text: 20 blanks to fill and your policy is ready to post.
body: Here's your no-show policy template: [Download the template]
Three steps to put it to work today:
1. Fill in the 9 sections. Each one has a finished salon example under it.
2. Post it on your booking page and paste it into your confirmation email.
3. Tell your front desk the rule for late arrivals (section 5), so everyone gives the same answer.
The policy works best when clients see it before they book and get a reminder with a cancel link. Example Booking Software does both for you: [See how reminders and deposits work]
Stuck on a section? Hit reply and tell us which one.
